about: A list of links to the headings on a page, with an indicator next to the headings in view.

following.about: The aside placement next to three sections of this page. The table of contents sticks to the top of the viewport while the page scrolls, and the indicator moves to the headings in view. Clicking a link scrolls the page to its heading.
following.title: Aside placement

palette.about: The eight semantic palettes, with the indicator on the second heading. The palette sets the indicator and the focus ring.
palette.title: Palettes

passage: This section gives the page enough height to scroll. The table of contents marks its heading while the heading is in view.
second: With the aside placement the table of contents is sticky. It stays in the viewport while this column scrolls, so the indicator stays visible.

size.about: Every size, with the indicator on the second heading. A heading at depth 3 is indented by one gap.
size.title: Sizes

third: Clicking a link scrolls the page to its heading and writes the heading's ID to the URL fragment. The indicator then moves to that heading.
title: Table of contents
